name: Massachusetts Championship 2019

venue.name: [Boston University](http://www.bu.edu/studentactivities/about-us/)
venue.details: In the big gym on the first floor of the BU Student Activities Office Building

information:
This is the third competition hosted at Boston University, this time with all 18 WCA events!

This is the state championship for Massachusetts, however anyone can attend. See more information on the [Massachusetts State Champion Eligibility Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MassachusettsChampionship2019#10653-champion-eligibility)

**Those not competing in FMC do not need to show up on Friday.**
